task_shape: Partner-facing REST API facade backed by local downstream carrier-rate and shipment-booking services.
skill_relevance: REST resource naming and response envelopes
cursor pagination and stable list links

main_tests: quote contract, sorting, filtering, and cursor pagination
shipment creation, idempotent replay, and idempotency conflict
shipment retrieval and partner resource isolation
authentication, validation, and semantic status codes
guardrail_tests: immutable data, contract, and downstream service hashes
downstream rate-service ledger proves real quote calls
downstream booking ledger proves create calls and idempotent replay suppression
gateway returns 502/503 when downstream services are invalid or unavailable

control_experiment_rule: with_skill and without_skill differ only by the presence of environment/skills and the runtime copy logic that removes that directory for without_skill.
